claim: The observed layer (OA/CP, episodes, lifecycle) is independent of intra-second fill order.
source: Implicit in 'chronological' ordering; M2B discloses sells-first/buys-first sensitivity of 20 fills / 5 instruments
independent_verification: Track A measured six alternative orders on the full ledger: OA/CP unit totals, final inventory, cash and AVG realized are invariant; episode identities, reversal count (20-23), OA/CP row membership and FIFO/LIFO attribution are NOT.
limitation: Raw timestamps are whole seconds; intra-second order is undecidable from the file. Trade id / order number agree with file order in 54-55 of 56 mixed-side groups and contradict it in two. No order was chosen.
